rationale.text: A select element carries size, and no other element carries a listed attribute. size is on the list, so the page does not meet the plain absence route, but the methodology excepts the select element for size and the glossary forbids size only on other elements. The exception applies and the test is met. The custom check answers no_fault (step 3: listed attributes only on excepted elements), so the finding is passed at full and needs_review, not_enabled, at fail_only.
